title: GTA 6 Unlocks Tonight: You Need 212 GB Free
caption:
GTA 6 launches November 19 and the download is up to 212 GB depending on your console (Rockstar). Pre-load has been open since November 10, physical copies are a code in a box, and Xbox Cloud Gaming streams it from 1 AM ET with no install.
How much free space do you have right now?

Sources: Rockstar Games, Xbox Wire, VGC, Game Informer
